note: Per the placeholder art policy: no blank rectangles or generic coloured circles are used as finished visuals. Phase 1 placeholders are procedurally drawn (Control._draw()) silhouettes/scenes in the game's established palette. Schema follows the art brief's Section 36 spec; see status_legend below for what each status value means in this project specifically.

status_legend.planned: Identified as needed, no work started
status_legend.concept: A generation prompt exists (see ART_GENERATION_PROMPTS.md) but no image has been produced
status_legend.draft: An image/asset exists but hasn't been reviewed for consistency/anatomy/perspective errors
status_legend.approved: Reviewed and matches the art direction, not yet wired into a scene
status_legend.integrated: Wired into its game scene(s) and confirmed working
status_legend.procedural_placeholder: Not a raster/vector asset at all - a Control._draw() script stands in for it, already integrated and functioning, tracked here so it's not mistaken for finished art. Not part of the brief's original status list; added because it's this project's dominant current status (see ART_ASSET_GUIDE.md).
status_legend.final: Integrated, optimised, and not expected to change before a real-art replacement pass
